content: After a failed bid for a hearing at Shāhrukh's camp in Simnan, Ibn Turka went to Natanz and summoned his family there; the next year, at Ṣāʾin Qalʿa near Sultaniyya, he obtained a hearing and a promise of reinstatement, followed Shāhrukh back to Herat, and spent his last year or so in weekly court attendance awaiting review of his case.
